name: Mia Frost
life: “I still remember realizing my third unanswered text was six months old.” Wednesday often includes a stop at Harbour Bakery, where Mia buys one familiar thing and asks who chose the unfamiliar thing in the window.
voice: I stopped sending messages after the first month. I was afraid to say the wrong thing so I disappeared.
appearance: Mia is easy to recognize by a loose dark braid and one cheek that creases before the other. Usually dressed in a boxy denim jacket with a square of clean cloth for polishing smudges, Mia gives a little nod before asking a hard question when listening.
personality: Mia never tires of being shown how somebody makes a living. Mia can ask an expert question of a craftsperson and still mishandle a simple emotional cue from a friend.
agenda: To restart an ordinary conversation after months of silence.
family: Dario Oh is Mia’s first cousin once removed. Mia chooses whether to use it. Dario saves a place. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The rescue hut mural*, Dario says, “I was her model. I held a sandwich in the hand that looks so noble now.”
connections: Drew Silva. The colleague learning the new form has reason to answer a message that stopped too early.
